text:
Type: extendable wall makeup mirror
Use: close-up grooming, shaving and makeup; bathroom, dressing area, bedroom
Style: contemporary, modern, industrial
Materials: polished stainless steel frame, bracket and scissor arm, mirror glass
Colors: shiny silver chrome, reflective glass
Shape: small round mirror in a thin metal ring, pivoting on a folding accordion arm that pulls out from a slim wall bracket, tilts and swivels, compact and light
Feel: practical, sleek, functional, tidy
Goes with: white tiles, chrome fixtures, grey or white walls; modern bathrooms or dressing corners
